en_mt.title: Russia is killing civilians!
en_mt.body: On 10 November Russians killed 2 residents of Donetchyna: in Kramatorsk and Slovyansk. Another 5 people in the region received injuries over the day. The total number of Russian victims in Donetchyna is given without taking into account Mariupol and Volnovakha.
